retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white close-up portrait framed by a black border, featuring a neon crayon-textured header and elegant serif typography.
triggerTerms: high-contrast monochrome portrait with neon scribbles
framed portrait on black background with header text

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast black and white male portrait wearing futuristic white-rimmed sunglasses, encased in a thin blue-glowing frame against a solid black field. The top section features a horizontal band of energetic, textured crayon scribbles in cyan and magenta, serving as a backdrop for two distinct serif text blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subject against a deep black negative space
Textured, vibrant header element contrasting with the smooth photographic skin tones
Thin, glowing rectangular frame containing the central subject
Symmetrical facial composition anchored by the bridge of the sunglasses
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photographic processing
Horizontal crayon-textured scribble band at the top
Thin, colored rectangular border around the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait, centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bridge of the futuristic sunglasses and the high-contrast nose shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes/sunglasses, moves upward to the textured header and text, then down to the chin and frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant solid black border surrounding the central framed image.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and Magenta (scribble texture and frame glow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast in the center; high saturation in the small header accents.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with color inversion for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif look of the era.
Provides the necessary sharp serifs and elegant stroke contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a man with futuristic white sunglasses, centered in a thin cyan-glowing frame on a solid black background. Add a horizontal band of cyan and magenta crayon scribbles across the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the primary text in black uppercase serif on the left side of the scribble band, and the secondary text in white uppercase serif on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is there a textured scribble band at the top?
Is the text in a high-contrast serif font?
Is the central image framed by a thin glowing line?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific celebrity likenesses
Do not replicate existing brand logos
Ensure the scribble texture is generated as a generic artistic element

mustAchieve: Distinct wax-crayon texture in the header
avoid: Digital-looking gradients instead of crayon texture

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the scribble background
Verify the thin border is consistent on all four sides of the portrait
Ensure the black and white processing doesn't lose facial detail
Confirm the scribble texture looks hand-drawn and tactile
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + thin glowing frame + textured header band + classic serif typography.
